{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of '999999.99' in revenue
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {len(qa_rows)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_rows = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_rows)}")

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and sum revenue
revenue_by_channel = df_completed.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending
top_channel = revenue_by_channel.loc[revenue_by_channel['revenue_clean'].idxmax()]

# Print results
print(revenue_by_channel)
print(f"Channel with most revenue: {top_channel['channel']} with {top_channel['revenue_clean']:.2f} USD")"}
